nutrition.description: The number of food points restored by this item when eaten. Must be a non-negative integer.

saturation.description: The amount of saturation restored by this item when eaten.

can_always_eat.description: If {{cd|true}}, this item can be eaten even if the player is not hungry. Defaults to {{cd|false}}.

food.description: The food stats for this consumable item. Has no effect unless the item can be consumed (i.e. the item has the {{cd|consumable}} component).
